project_type: Django 4.2 + DRF backend (backend/), React 18 + Vite + TanStack Query frontend (frontend/), PostgreSQL 15, Redis 7, Celery + Django Channels
build_system: Django manage.py (backend), Vite (frontend). Backend root is backend/, NOT the repo root. All manage.py commands must be run from backend/. Frontend is in frontend/.
test_framework: Django built-in test runner (python manage.py test). Frontend: no test framework found (no vitest/jest config). Config module is backend/config/settings.py; test settings at backend/config/test_settings.py.
build_command: cd backend && python manage.py check   |   cd frontend && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. cd backend && python manage.py check (zero errors). 2. python manage.py makemigrations --check (no pending migrations). 3. python manage.py test (all tests pass). 4. cd frontend && npm run build (no TS errors). 5. npm run lint (zero warnings).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Migration files in each app's migrations/ directory. After adding indexes to models, run: python manage.py makemigrations <app> --name <descriptive>. These get committed.
environment_constraints: No new infrastructure (no new DBs, brokers, monitoring platforms). Docker Compose runs postgres:15-alpine and redis:7-alpine only. Redis requires password (REDIS_PASSWORD env var). CONN_MAX_AGE not yet set in DATABASES config. No react-window or react-virtual in frontend package.json — do not introduce them. No test runner in frontend — only build/lint checks.
contribution_requirements: Financial operations (payments, refunds, accounting, audit): PostgreSQL is single source of truth; never use cache locks as sole protection for financial correctness. Never trust frontend-supplied tenant IDs for cache scoping. Do not remove or weaken Phase 1-21 security/auth/audit controls. Never delete historical business data. No destructive DB operations.
key_patterns: All models inherit TimestampedModel (created_at, updated_at). UUID PKs throughout. Views follow access-module pattern: app_name.access.get_accessible_<resource>(user). Service layer handles business logic. Models already have many indexes defined in Meta.indexes. Reporting app already has django.core.cache usage (reporting/services.py uses cache.get/set with CACHE_TTL_* constants from reporting/constants.py). Cache backend is django.core.cache.backends.redis.RedisCache. CACHES already configured in settings.py. Celery tasks in notifications/tasks.py, crm/tasks.py, marketing/tasks.py — no tasks in other apps. KitchenConsumer and CentralControlConsumer already have select_related/prefetch_related in _get_current_state. DRF pagination: DEFAULT_PAGINATION_CLASS=PageNumberPagination, PAGE_SIZE=20 already set globally. Frontend uses TanStack Query v5 for all API calls (hooks in src/hooks/). No virtualised list library present.
directory_structure: backend/ — Django project root. backend/config/ — settings, celery, urls, asgi. One directory per Django app. backend/core/models.py — TimestampedModel base. frontend/ — Vite/React project. frontend/src/hooks/ — TanStack Query hooks. frontend/src/pages/ — one subdirectory per feature area. frontend/src/services/ — axios API service files. performance/ — existing Locust directory (scenarios/, test_data/, README.md). docs/ — existing docs directory at repo root. .agents/tasks/phase22-performance/ — artifact root for this task.
